provenance.vc_model: vc-v4: mathematical integers on defined C executions; target limits not instantiated; shared typed memory; typed reads are representable; substantive obligations; entry consistency

fuzz_domain.equalities: REQUIRES conjuncts `p == literal` and `p == q` are assigned after sampling (p a scalar parameter)

settings.family: dynamic inference over loop-head states: `v == c`, `v == w + c`, `v == a*w + b` (a in {-2, -1, 2}), `c <= v`, `v <= c`, `v <= w + c` with observed extremes, `v == w + x`, `v == w - x`, `v == w * x`, and implications `cond => e` from call-free scalar branch conditions in the loop body (written as disjunctions); every literal of absolute value at most 8; at most 40 candidates per loop; 200 fuzz draws plus 200 profile draws when a profile binds; a loop with fewer than 20 observed head states gets no candidate
settings.smt_encoding: z3-int-shared-memory-v2; C division truncates to zero; division by zero totalized to 0
